API documentation

RentLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. Use any OpenAI SDK or plain HTTP.

Authentication

Pass your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

List models

curl https://rent.broomy.laserraptor.eu/api/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

Chat completions

curl https://rent.broomy.laserraptor.eu/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen3.8-flash",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello!"}],
    "stream": false
  }'

Streaming

Set stream: true to receive Server-Sent Events in OpenAI format.

Using the OpenAI SDK (Python)

from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://rent.broomy.laserraptor.eu/api/v1",
    api_key="YOUR_API_KEY",
)
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen3.8-flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
